messages:
emma-cs: Heads-up: scheduling Meridian dedicated bring-up on Thu 09:00 UTC. Goal: validate committed quota, run autoscale exercise, and produce a short renewal note. Need owners for quotas, runbook, and customer enablement.
liam-ops: I can lock capacity. Proposal: reserve 6 GPUs for the window (+2 buffer). Tag resources meridian-dedicated-feb. Will post terraform plan by EOD.
zara-ml: We'll target model Meridian-H-3B and keep Meridian-H-3B-quant as fallback. Perf note: p95 can drift with cold KV; suggest a 5k-prefix warm and prefix priming during smoke.
mike-sre: Suggest test cadence: 10m smoke, 30m gradual ramp to 200 QPS, 20m steady, 10m controlled failover test. Set pager and a 15m canary route at start. If 5xx > 1% for 3m, trigger fallback.
emma-cs: Customer enablement: 08:30 UTC walk-through (15m) covering token limits, routing, and how to raise exclusions. I'll draft a 1-page checklist and share.
kai-eng: I'll add the loadgen snippet and KV warm script into the runbook. Example command:
python -m loadgen --routes meridian-mix.json --target 200 --duration 60 --warm-prefix 5000
Include a flag to toggle packet-loss injection.
liam-ops: Autoscale policy draft: min_pods=3, max_pods=10, cpu_target=65%, scale_step=+1, cooldown=45s. I'll align reserved GPUs to accommodate max_pods at expected pod-to-GPU ratio.
zara-ml: Post-run checks: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, batch size histogram, cache hit ratio, GPU util, and quality evals (safety + intent). We'll run short eval suites against both default and quant variants.
mike-sre: I'll prepare a short fallback command list (route switch, rate-limit non-critical routes to 75%, enable quant pool). ops-bot: playbook template attached: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated-priming-template
emma-cs: Deliverables after test: one-line renewal risk (green/amber/red) with reason, short slide with perf vs committed expectations, and per-1M-token cost estimate for finance.
liam-ops: Noted. Owners: Liam = capacity & infra, Mike = oncall & fallback, Kai = runbook & load scripts, Zara = perf + eval, Emma = customer comms + renewal note.
emma-cs: OK I'll send invites and the enablement doc. Please flag any routes to exclude by Wed 12:00 UTC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
